PHOENIX V27 — FULL-SCREEN TWO-COLUMN NAVIGATION
November 15, 2026
Baseline v26: 97b04aeb2bfba31b154998cef22771b95eeb8710

The wolf navigation overlay now occupies the entire viewport. Large illustrated
buttons form two columns, with the fifth centered on the final row. The gallery
scrolls independently; Close remains visible above it. Message history remains
available when present. Underlying wolf/warning controls are hidden while the
primary overlay is open and restored unchanged on closure.

Approved artwork, effect sequencing, category backlights, silver markers, immediate
routing, player saves, warning/Undo state and reader behavior are retained. Up/Down
keyboard movement follows the two-column grid and brings focused cards into view.
Source-page scroll, focus and expanded state continue to use existing restoration.

Validation: all 133 automated tests pass. Chromium rendered at 320x640, 390x844
and 568x320. At 390px phone width, artwork is approximately 153.5x230.25px,
compared with the prior compact-row artwork. The overlay measures 390x844 exactly.
Keyboard movement reached the fifth card through independent gallery scrolling;
Close stayed at y=12. Native Escape closed the overlay. Reader scroll restored
936 to 936, source wolf became visible again and reader inert/lock state cleared.
Physical iPhone Safari and VoiceOver remain owner/device acceptance checks.

Only navigation is migrated here. Other modal conversions are recorded in
OVERLAY-DESIGN-DECISIONS.txt for bounded implementation; no claim they are complete.
LT diagram corrections remain unpublished and untouched.
Rollback: restore saved v26; no save-schema changes.
